blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Light Rail Transit (LRT) Line 2 will temporarily operate with nine trains from Tuesday to Sunday while it upgrades its train system, the Light Rail Transit Authority (LRTA) said. The LRTA said that only nine trains will run every Tuesday to Sunday in the LRT-2 line, which may cause longer waiting times and an increase in passenger volume. This, as it is upgrading the Train Operating Control Panel (TOCP) of LRT-2 line trains, which takes five days per train, according to the LRTA. “The shift from the old analog system to the digital TOCP aims to enhance the […]...
